items.t: 2027 GRIs repeat 5.9% average; announcement dates move
items.body: FedEx announced its 2027 GRI, a 5.9% average, on 2026-09-18, effective Jan. 4, 2027; the 2026 GRI was announced 2025-09-12, effective Jan. 5, 2026. UPS announced its 5.9% average on 2026-10-23, effective Dec. 21, 2026; its 2026 GRI was announced 2025-10-31, effective Dec. 22, 2025. Both carriers averaged 6.9% for 2023, and FedEx's 5.9% is its fourth straight headline at that level.

items.t: USPS pairs a 5.9% January rise with a permanent 11% fuel charge
items.body: USPS's January 17, 2027 final rule raises Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail and Ground Advantage 5.9% overall. The January 2026 change (announced 2025-11-14) was 6.6% for Priority Mail, 5.1% for Express and 7.8% for Ground Advantage, and January 2025 was 3.2% for Priority Mail and 3.9% for Ground Advantage. USPS also filed on Nov. 12, 2026 to convert the temporary 8% charge, in effect since Apr. 26, 2026, into a permanent 11% fuel surcharge on Jan. 17, 2027, pending PRC review; in the January 2021 change USPS noted no fuel surcharge.

items.t: 2026 peak add-ons exceed 2025 levels at UPS, FedEx and USPS
items.body: For the Nov. 23–Dec. 27, 2026 window FedEx lists Ground residential at $0.80 (2025: $0.65), Additional Handling at $11.85 ($10.90) and Oversize at $117.25 ($108.50). UPS lists Large Package at $117.50 for Nov. 22–Dec. 26 against $107 in 2025; the New York Post put the oversize increase at nearly 10% for UPS and roughly 8% for FedEx. USPS's retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage Zone 1-4 0-3 lb add-on is $0.50 in 2026, against $0.40 in 2025 and $0.30 in 2024, and is stacked on the temporary 8%.

items.t: Fuel table changes continue off-cycle at higher percentage levels
items.body: UPS domestic fuel tables changed on Jan. 5, Mar. 9 (the third UPS fuel increase of 2026), Aug. 10, Nov. 2 and Nov. 16, 2026; the last was announced Nov. 12 and adds 0.50 points per price band. In 2025 UPS tables rose Mar. 10 (+0.50) and May 26 (+1.00). FedEx moved its diesel table pivot from $3.55 to $4.99 on June 1, 2026, and TheStreet reported its fuel surcharge at 30.5% on Nov. 12, 2026, versus the 20% UPS and FedEx Ground levels of June 2025.

items.t: Dimension-based surcharges keep rising into 2027 rates
items.body: UPS's 2027 GRI (announced 2026-10-23, effective Dec. 21, 2026) raises the Additional Handling minimum billable weight from 40 lb, the level set in the 2025 GRI, to 50 lb. FedEx's Jan. 4, 2027 changes lift Additional Handling to $31.75-$43.75 by zone from $29.50-$40.75, after cubic-volume triggers were added in January 2026 by FedEx (Jan. 12) and UPS (Jan. 26). A new UPS origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers takes effect Dec. 21, 2026 or later, with no amount released.

items.t: Per-pound international surge fees are new in 2026, with no end dates
items.body: In 2025 UPS and FedEx international peak fees ran $0.10 to $0.52 per lb over set windows. In 2026 UPS added $1.34/lb on U.S.-Middle East shipments (Mar. 22) and a $0.23/lb Surge Emergency Fee (Apr. 19), and announced Nov. 12 a rise on China/Hong Kong/Macau-to-U.S. from $0.91 to $1.03 per lb, effective Nov. 16. FedEx added Zone K fees of $0.50/lb on exports and $0.70/lb on imports (Mar. 5) and a Vietnam-to-U.S. surcharge of $0.36/lb priority and $0.27/lb economy (Nov. 2).
